'FAIL' then 'OUT' else r.result_status end from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 1 and case when r.result_status = 'FAIL' then 'OUT' else r.result_status end from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 1 and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_first_round_status, (select case when r.result_status = 'FAIL' then 'OUT' else r.result_status end from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_second_round_status, (select r.score from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.first_choice limit and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_second_round_score, (select r.update_by from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.first_choice limit 1) as first_choice_second_round_score_update_by, (select r.update_time from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.first_choice limit 1) as first_choice_second_round_score_update_time, (select r.update_by from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_second_round_score_update_by, (select r.update_time from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 2 and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_second_round_score_update_time , (select r.interview_time from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 1 and r.interview_time is not null order by case when r.department = a.first_choice then 0 else 1 end limit 1) as first_round_interview_time
, (select case when r.result_status = 'FAIL' then 'OUT' else r.result_status end from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = #{roundId} and r.department = a.first_choice limit 1) as first_choice_status, (select case when r.result_status = 'FAIL' then 'OUT' else r.result_status end from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = #{roundId} and r.department = a.second_choice limit 1) as second_choice_status
from qt_interview_application a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.user_id
and a.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%') and a.apply_status = #{applyStatus}
and (a.first_choice = #{department} or a.second_choice = #{department})
and (a.first_choice = #{scopedDepartment} or a.second_choice = #{scopedDepartment})
and exists ( select 1 from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = 1 and r.result_status = 'PASS' and r.department = #{scopedDepartment} and r.department = #{department} )
and exists ( select 1 from qt_interview_result r join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.application_id = a.application_id and rd.round_no = #{roundId} and (r.result_status = #{resultStatus} or (#{resultStatus} = 'OUT' and r.result_status = 'FAIL')) and r.department = #{scopedDepartment} and r.department = #{department} )
